title: Open Infrastructure Bill of Materials (I-BOM)
description: A cross-vendor, open format for infrastructure BOMs. One document describes physical hardware, firmware, software, virtual and cloud resources, licenses, consumables, labor and soft costs, plus the lifecycle, drift, supply-chain, security (SBOM), sustainability (Scope 3) and ERP/CMDB data needed to keep it live. Designed to align with CycloneDX 1.6: bom-ref identifiers, component types, dependencies and purl/cpe carry over one-to-one, and I-BOM-only data maps to CycloneDX properties under the 'ibom:' namespace.

serialNumber.description: Globally unique id of this I-BOM (same convention as CycloneDX).

version.description: Increments on every change to this I-BOM; combine with serialNumber for audit trail.

organizations.description: Manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, integrators, cloud providers and service firms referenced by components.

locations.description: Physical and logical placement tree: site > building > room > row > rack, or cloud account > region > zone.

relationships.description: Typed graph edges between components (contains, runs-on, powered-by...). Feeds a topology/graph database.

dependencies.description: CycloneDX-compatible dependency list. Optional; exporters derive it from 'relationships' if absent.

baselines.description: Approved blueprint snapshots that drift detection compares live state against.

observations.description: Discovered live state and drift findings, including shadow infrastructure not in the BOM.

changes.description: Engineering / configuration change records (ECO/ECN/RFC) affecting this I-BOM.

bomRef.description: Identifier unique within this document (CycloneDX bom-ref).

properties.description: Free-form name/value pairs (CycloneDX-compatible). Use namespaced names, e.g. 'acme:costCode'.

extensions.description: Structured vendor or enterprise extensions keyed by a reverse-DNS or URL namespace. Values are unconstrained. Covers the Field Guide's CUSTOM PROPERTIES.

timestamp.description: When this version was produced (Field Guide: TIME STAMP).

tools.description: Tools that generated or enriched this I-BOM (ingestion engine, discovery agents, IaC parsers).

bomViews.description: Which BOM views this document serves (from the BOM Types reference). One I-BOM can serve several.

revision.description: Human revision label, e.g. 'B' or '2026.09-rc1' (Field Guide: REVISION & VERSION).

supersedes.description: serialNumber of the I-BOM this one replaces.

licenses.description: License of the I-BOM document itself (SPDX ids).

ilmPhase.description: Infrastructure Lifecycle Management phase: Plan (ILM), Acquire (Supply Management), Prepare (Systems Readiness), Deploy (Systems Deployment), Operate, Retire.

changeRef.description: id of the change record that introduced this effectivity.

risk.description: Supplier-level risk profile, written by the supply-chain risk engine.

rack.description: Rack-specific capacity. Use when type = rack.

facility.description: Facility energy data used for operational carbon (Scope 2) alongside embodied carbon (Scope 3).

class.description: Top-level I-BOM category. Maps to CycloneDX component types via the exporter.

category.description: Finer classification, e.g. server, gpu, cpu, memory, nic, dpu, switch, router, optic, cable, pdu, ups, cdu, rack, os, hypervisor, driver, orchestrator, vm, container-cluster, object-storage, installation, disposal-fee.

partNumber.description: Internal part number / component id (Field Guide: PART NUMBER/COMPONENT ID).

manufacturer.description: bom-ref of an organization with role manufacturer.

purl.description: Package URL, for software and firmware.

cpe.description: CPE 2.3 name, used for vulnerability matching of hardware and firmware.

parent.description: bom-ref of the parent assembly (multi-level BOM). Equivalent to a 'contains' relationship.

findNumber.description: Line / item number within the parent.

units.description: Serialized instances when quantity > 1 and each unit is tracked (as-built / as-maintained).

configuration.description: Declared configuration (desired state) for this component. Keys are free-form; drift detection compares these against observed values.

alternates.description: Approved form-fit-function alternates (Field Guide: ALTERNATE PART NUMBER).

substitutes.description: Conditional substitutes (Field Guide: SUBSTITUTE PART NUMBER).

inherited.description: Field Guide: INHERITED — line comes from a template/modular BOM.

procurementType.description: Field Guide: PROCUREMENT TYPE / MAKE VS BUY.

criticality.description: Field Guide: CRITICALITY / SAFETY LEVEL. Drives drift and supply-risk alerting severity.

location.description: bom-ref of a location (rack, room, cloud region...).

physical.description: Physical attributes (Field Guide: DIMS, MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS) plus power and cooling profile.

formFactor.description: e.g. 1U, 2U, 4U, 8U, OCP, SXM, OAM, PCIe FHFL, QSFP-DD, OSFP.

liquidFractionPct.description: Share of heat captured by liquid loop.

coolantType.description: e.g. PG25, deionized water, dielectric fluid.

acceleratorInterconnect.description: e.g. NVLink 4 / NVSwitch, Infinity Fabric, ICI.

role.description: e.g. leaf, spine, tor, oob-mgmt, border.

mediaType.description: e.g. SR4, DR4, FR4, DAC, AOC, OM4, SMF.

endpoints.description: For cables: the two ends, as bom-ref plus port.

software.description: Firmware, OS, hypervisor, driver, platform software.

targetComponent.description: Hardware this firmware/software is installed on. Also expressible as a 'runs-on' relationship.

virtual.description: Virtual and cloud resource specifics. Bridges IaC and cloud inventories into the same BOM.

resourceType.description: Provider-native type, e.g. aws_instance, Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines, v1/Namespace.

resourceId.description: ARN, Azure resource id, GCP self-link, VM UUID.

iac.description: Where this resource is declared, for IaC-to-BOM reconciliation.

source.description: Repository URL and path of the declaring file.

metric.description: e.g. per-GPU, per-socket, per-core, per-node, per-user.

role.description: e.g. rack-and-stack technician, network engineer, electrician, project manager.

provider.description: Organization supplying the labor, if external.

workInstructions.description: Field Guide: WORK INSTRUCTIONS; URL or document id.

lifecycleStatus.description: 'discovered-unmanaged' marks shadow infrastructure found by discovery but not yet approved into the BOM.

source.description: e.g. redfish, ipmi, snmp, dcgm, gnmi, cloudwatch, otel.

lifecycle.description: Dynamic lifecycle tracking: status, key dates, health and event history. Replaces the static-spreadsheet view.

vendorLifecycle.description: Manufacturer lifecycle milestones; the obsolescence signal for fast-moving AI hardware.

stage.description: nrnd = not recommended for new designs.

events.description: Append-only history (firmware updates, RMAs, moves, config changes).

supply.description: Multi-tier supply chain data for risk prediction and alternate sourcing.

predicted.description: Model output from the predictive logistics engine.

gpoContract.description: Group purchasing organization contract id, if bought through a GPO.

subTierDependencies.description: Hidden critical sub-components (tier 2+), e.g. HBM, substrate, laser die, PSU controller IC. The layer that usually stalls a build.

risk.description: Component-level supply risk, written by the risk engine.

delayProbability.description: Probability the item misses its need-by date.

qualified.description: Validated for use in this design.

impact.description: Known differences: power, performance, firmware, lead time.

security.description: Unified hardware-software security: links each item to its SBOM/HBOM, VEX and advisories so a zero-day in firmware can be traced to every affected rack.

bomLink.description: CycloneDX BOM-Link to the exact document/version/component.

id.description: CVE, GHSA or vendor advisory id.

kev.description: Listed in CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities.

rootOfTrust.description: e.g. TPM 2.0, Caliptra, OpenTitan, vendor HRoT.

provenance.description: Supply chain provenance evidence, e.g. platform certificate, SLSA attestation URL.

sustainability.description: Scope 3 embodied carbon and end-of-life data, plus operating energy for Scope 2.

kgCO2e.description: Per unit, cradle-to-gate unless boundary says otherwise.

stages.description: Breakdown by life-cycle stage, kgCO2e per unit.

scope3Categories.description: GHG Protocol Scope 3 categories (1 purchased goods, 2 capital goods, 4 upstream transport, 12 end-of-life).

annualEnergyKwh.description: Expected annual IT energy per unit.

certifications.description: e.g. EPEAT Gold, ENERGY STAR, TCO Certified.

financial.description: Field Guide: COST / UNIT COST / EXTENDED COST, plus ERP accounting fields.

extendedCost.description: unitCost x quantity; validators check it.

systemIdentifiers.description: Keys into enterprise systems so ERP, CMDB, DCIM, cloud and IaC views of the same item stay linked.

system.description: e.g. SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, Dynamics 365.
e.g. ServiceNow, BMC Helix, Device42, NetBox.

driftControl.description: Per-component drift policy: which attributes are tracked and how deviations are handled.

attributes.description: JSON Pointers into this component, e.g. '/version', '/configuration/mtu', '/placement/rackUnit'.

compliance.description: e.g. RoHS, REACH, WEEE, TAA, NDAA 889, FIPS 140-3.

bomVersion.description: The I-BOM version this baseline froze.

scope.description: Components (or locations) covered. Empty array = whole BOM.

digest.description: Hash over the canonicalised tracked attributes, for fast whole-baseline comparison.

expected.description: Explicit expected values per component attribute.

source.description: Discovery source that reported this (see driftControl.discoverySources).

kind.description: unmanaged = shadow infrastructure: present live, absent from BOM.

component.description: BOM component concerned; absent for unmanaged items.

discovered.description: For unmanaged items: what was found, in component shape where possible.

externalRef.description: Change ticket in ITSM/PLM, e.g. ServiceNow CHG number.
